title: Quick Sort
description: Write a Zig program that implements the quicksort algorithm with Lomuto partition scheme.
verificationTest: output.includes('1') && output.includes('5') && output.includes('7') && output.includes('8') && output.includes('9') && output.includes('10')
hints: QuickSort picks a pivot and partitions the array around it
After partition, the pivot is in its final sorted position
Recursively sort elements before and after the pivot
Use slice notation `[]i32` for flexible array handling
